Chi-Yu's Specs Overheat OHKOs Zamazenta at any Defence stage (528 into 403, minimum 449) and Melmetal (691 into 492); Dark Pulse OHKOs Marshadow (495 into 399); Specs Overheat OHKOs Zapdos (594). Beads of Ruin cuts every foe's Sp. Def by a quarter, which turns Landorus's Life Orb Sheer Force Earth Power into a guaranteed OHKO on Zamazenta (504) and Melmetal; Landorus is immune to Thunder and resists Body Press. Zekrom is the Zapdos wall (resists Hurricane and Thunder) with Band Fusion Bolt (580 on Kyogre if it survives turn 1, 407 on Marshadow). Whimsicott Encore locks Iron Defense or Protect, Taunt stops it before it starts.
